cloud_writes.what: creates the site (stays in the account) and its offline map download to the tablet
creates the flight QA_{target} Partly outside offline offline; synced when back online (stays there; its plan is never saved)
the planner's Save only opens Flight overview; the case closes it with X, nothing is saved

expected: Offline, a QA_ flight created in its downloaded QA_ site with its area partly outside the site: Flight overview shows 'Flight elements outside of site boundaries' and Save & exit is disabled.
forbidden: Save & exit or any other save
Delete or archive (the QA_ site and flight stay)
any site other than the one this case creates

parts.quote: Enable offline use through site creation
parts.text: Stand-in: my own QA_ site with Enable offline use, downloaded

parts.quote: Create a flight plan with flight area which is partially inside the site area and partially outside
parts.text: Offline: create a flight, area partly outside the site, take-off inside

parts.quote: It’s only possible to save flights that are inside the site’s boundary
parts.text: Offline: Save & exit disabled, outside-site warning shown

preconditions.text: tablet online at start (the case switches Wi-Fi off itself)

requirement.text:
For testing this use Hedingen_Network_Correction site, the site is already downloaded. Than turn off the internet and proceed with thesting. 

Flights crossing the site boundary
Create a flight plan with flight area which is partially inside the site area and partially outside
 It’s only possible to save flights that are inside the site’s boundary
Create a flight which the flight area is fully outside the site area
 Same as above
For an existing site with downloaded tiles, create a flight plan with a flight area outside the site. Then modify the site area so it covers the flight with its flight area. 
V: These are separate operations: creating a flight plan with flight area outside of the site boundary is possible offline, modifying a site triggers its map to update. 
Create a flight plan with flight area which is inside the site area. Then save, edit and move the flight outside the site area.

routing.symbol: default site box 395x240 px at SITE_LOCATION_ZOOM 14
tabletZoom 15: the planner opens centred on the site

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap text:Exit --expect "js:!/Do you really want to exit\?/.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 20
steps.text: Leave a flight setup's 'Do you want to exit?' dialog when one is open (Exit; writes nothing)
Stop when the planner shows a flight that is not Hover's own (name not starting with QA_): a person's flight is never left or dropped; close it by hand, then run again

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving|Do you really want to exit\?/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20
steps.text: Top bar: Sites (a planner or a flight setup left open asks first)
Exit without saving, when the planner asks (writes nothing)
Exit, when a flight setup asks 'Do you want to exit?' (writes nothing)
New site (opens site creation with the name field)
Site name: QA_{target} Boundary offline {time}
Location: type the lat/long 47.352000, 8.491000
Pick the lat/long suggestion: the map centres there at zoom 14 and the default site area is set

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap "text:Enable offline use" --expect "js:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')].some(e => { let p = e; for (let i = 0; i < 4 && p; i++) { if (/Enable offline use/.test(p.innerText || '')) return e.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'; p = p.parentElement; } return false; })" --timeout 15
steps.text: Turn on Enable offline use
Next (storage check; goes to the coordinate system step)
Save new site: creates the QA_ site (cloud write) and starts its offline download

steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "js:/Site available offline|Offline map not up to date|Waiting to resume download|Failed to make|Cannot make site available offline|Not enough storage/.test(document.body.innerText)" --timeout 300
steps.text: Wait until the site download ends: available, not up to date, waiting or failed (up to 5 min)
Turn off the internet: Wi-Fi off on the tablet; wait until the app shows it is offline
Create flight (opens the New flight form)

steps.helper: act.py {target} type testid:new-flight-name-input --text "QA_{target} Partly outside offline"
steps.text: Flight name: QA_{target} Partly outside offline
Create, offline: creates the QA_ flight in the downloaded site (synced later; cloud write) and opens its planner

steps.helper: act.py {target} wait --expect "text:Create area and take-off point" --timeout 60
steps.text: Wait until the empty planner is loaded
Area tool on (its button shows the active ring)
Area corner 1 at 0.03, 0.4 of the map
Area corner 2 at 0.2, 0.4 of the map
Area corner 3 at 0.2, 0.56 of the map
Area corner 4 at 0.03, 0.56 of the map, finished (row A1 - Area)
Take-off tool on (its button shows the active ring)
Take-off at 0.26, 0.48, inside the site (row T - Take off)
Save (planner): opens Flight overview for the QA_ flight (writes nothing itself)
Wait until Flight overview has finished its mission checks (Save & exit shows its label)
Screenshot: Flight overview offline

steps.read_js: ({offline: !navigator.onLine, warning: [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] *')].some(e => (e.innerText || '').trim() === 'Flight elements outside of site boundaries' && e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0), save_exit_disabled: !!(document.querySelector('[data-testid=btn-save-and-exit]') || {}).disabled})
steps.text: Check: offline, the outside-site warning shows and Save & exit is disabled
Clean-up: close Flight overview without saving (X; only when it is open)

steps.helper: act.py {target} tap testid:btn-sites --expect "js:/Exit without saving|Do you really want to exit\?/.test(document.body.innerText) || location.pathname === '/sites'" --timeout 20
steps.text: Clean-up: leave the planner (always; a planner showing a flight that is not Hover's own stays as it is)
Exit without saving when asked (always; writes nothing; only for Hover's own flight)
Exit when a flight setup asks 'Do you want to exit?' (always; writes nothing)
Clean-up: Wi-Fi back on (always)

steps_note: Written 2026-11-11 from New test W-20261111-004, from OFFL-004 c1. Stand-in: a new QA_ site of Hover's own for the person's Hedingen_Network_Correction (own sites only). Wi-Fi goes off after the download, then the flight is created and drawn offline. Offline the planner fits the map to the site bbox (FlightPlanningMap.tsx offlineFlightBounds, MapContext fitBounds), so the area's left corners sit at x 0.03, in the thin band left of the site; if they land inside, the check fails for a test reason (the result screenshot shows it). map-tap runs on a device for the first time.
